title: Attract pages: spotlight backdrop, smaller prompt, clearer table
why: The critic scored how to play 3 and the board 2: flat black, a 32px prompt far from the card, faint column headers, identical rows. Backdrop spotlight, accent rule under the wordmark, a lower prompt, lined table, 840px card. Restyle only.
now: The attract pages look cleaner and easier to read.

edits.anchor: body #attract .arcstrip{ font:600 calc(var(--fs-body) * var(--attz,1))/1.4 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--acc); }
